guidance: Export-stage defects: re-run fab_export.py (fresh out dir) and re-check with dfm_check.py before re-gating.

violations.msg: The board is fabricated at 0.127 mm copper clearance, not the 0.2 mm its own netclasses declare. Measured pad-to-pour gap is 0.127 mm on every isolated pad (C1.1, C1.2, C2.2, J1.1, J1.2, J2.2, U1.1, U1.3 - all identical), while bb-ldo.kicad_pro puts +5V/+3V3/GND in Pwr_0p255mm / Pwr_0p2575mm with clearance 0.2 and the zone itself declares (connect_pads yes (clearance 0.5)). Mechanism to confirm: bb-ldo.kicad_dru's 'aiee_clearance_floor' constrains clearance min 0.1270mm with NO condition, so it matches every object pair and outranks the netclass it was meant to floor; rules_gen emits per-net rules for track_width only, never for clearance, so nothing wins it back - despite the file's own header claiming 'per-net design rules last (later rule wins)'. Consequence on THIS board is mild (0.127 mm is JLC's 2-layer minimum, DRC is 0/0, and the pour is marginally larger than modelled), but the board is built with zero etch and registration margin where the design intended 57 % more, and this is a generated-rules defect that reaches every board the pipeline makes - including ones where the gap is a safety clearance.

scope: fix ONLY these violations; do not touch unrelated nets/regions; re-run the failed gate when done
